record.bible_text: As snow<WH07950> in summer<WH07019>, and as rain<WH04306> in harvest<WH07105>, so honour<WH03519> is not seemly<WH05000> for a fool<WH03684>.<CM>

A whip<WH07752> for the horse<WH05483>, a bridle<WH04964> for the ass<WH02543>, and a rod<WH07626> for the fool's<WH03684> back<WH01460>.<CM>

Answer<WH06030><WTH8798> a fool<WH03684> according to his folly<WH0200>, lest he be wise<WH02450> in his own conceit<WH05869>. <RF>conceit: Heb. eyes<Rf><CM>

<FI> As<Fi> a thorn<WH02336> goeth up<WH05927><WTH8804> into the hand<WH03027> of a drunkard<WH07910>, so <FI>is<Fi> a parable<WH04912> in the mouth<WH06310> of fools<WH03684>.<CM>

The great<WH07227> <FI>God<Fi> that formed<WH02342><WTH8789> all <FI>things<Fi> both rewardeth<WH07936><WTH8802> the fool<WH03684>, and rewardeth<WH07936><WTH8802> transgressors<WH05674><WTH8802>. <RF>The great...: or, A great man grieveth all, and he hireth the fool, he hireth also transgressors<Rf><CM>

As a dog<WH03611> returneth<WH07725><WTH8804> to his vomit<WH06892>, <FI>so<Fi> a fool<WH03684> returneth<WH08138><WTH8802> to his folly<WH0200>. <RF>returneth to his folly: Heb. iterateth his folly<Rf><CM>
Seest<WH07200><WTH8804> thou a man<WH0376> wise<WH02450> in his own conceit<WH05869>? <FI>there is<Fi> more hope<WH08615> of a fool<WH03684> than of him.<CM>
The slothful<WH06102> <FI>man<Fi> saith<WH0559><WTH8804>, <FI>There is<Fi> a lion<WH07826> in the way<WH01870>; a lion<WH0738> <FI>is<Fi> in the streets<WH07339>.<CM>
<FI> As<Fi> the door<WH01817> turneth<WH05437><WTH8735> upon his hinges<WH06735>, so <FI>doth<Fi> the slothful<WH06102> upon his bed<WH04296>.<CM>

The slothful<WH06102> hideth<WH02934><WTH8804> his hand<WH03027> in <FI>his<Fi> bosom<WH06747>; it grieveth<WH03811><WTH8738> him to bring it again<WH07725><WTH8687> to his mouth<WH06310>. <RF>it grieveth...: or, he is weary<Rf><CM>
The sluggard<WH06102> <FI>is<Fi> wiser<WH02450> in his own conceit<WH05869> than seven men<WH07651> that can render<WH07725><WTH8688> a reason<WH02940>.<CM>

He that passeth by<WH05674><WTH8802>, <FI>and<Fi> meddleth<WH05674><WTH8693> with strife<WH07379> <FI>belonging<Fi> not to him, <FI>is like<Fi> one that taketh<WH02388><WTH8688> a dog<WH03611> by the ears<WH0241>. <RF>meddleth: or, is enraged<Rf><CM>
As a mad<WH03856><WTH8700> <FI>man<Fi> who casteth<WH03384><WTH8802> firebrands<WH02131>, arrows<WH02671>, and death<WH04194>, <RF>firebrands: Heb. flames, or, sparks<Rf>
So <FI>is<Fi> the man<WH0376> <FI>that<Fi> deceiveth<WH07411><WTH8765> his neighbour<WH07453>, and saith<WH0559><WTH8804>, Am not I in sport<WH07832><WTH8764>?<CM>

Where no<WH0657> wood<WH06086> is, <FI>there<Fi> the fire<WH0784> goeth out<WH03518><WTH8799>: so where <FI>there is<Fi> no talebearer<WH05372>, the strife<WH04066> ceaseth<WH08367><WTH8799>. <RF>Where no...: Heb. Without wood<Rf> <RF>talebearer: or, whisperer<Rf> <RF>ceaseth: Heb. is silent<Rf>

<FI> As<Fi> coals<WH06352> <FI>are<Fi> to burning coals<WH01513>, and wood<WH06086> to fire<WH0784>; so <FI>is<Fi> a contentious<WH04079><WTH8675><WH04066> man<WH0376> to kindle<WH02787><WTH8771> strife<WH07379>.

The words<WH01697> of a talebearer<WH05372> <FI>are<Fi> as wounds<WH03859><WTH8693>, and they go down<WH03381><WTH8804> into the innermost parts<WH02315> of the belly<WH0990>. <RF>innermost...: Heb. chambers<Rf><CM>
Burning<WH01814><WTH8801> lips<WH08193> and a wicked<WH07451> heart<WH03820> <FI>are like<Fi> a potsherd<WH02789> covered<WH06823><WTH8794> with silver<WH03701> dross<WH05509>.<CM>
He that hateth<WH08130><WTH8802> dissembleth<WH05234><WTH8735> with his lips<WH08193>, and layeth up<WH07896><WTH8799> deceit<WH04820> within<WH07130> him; <RF>dissembleth: or, is known<Rf>

When he speaketh<WH06963> fair<WH02603><WTH8762>, believe<WH0539><WTH8686> him not: for <FI>there are<Fi> seven<WH07651> abominations<WH08441> in his heart<WH03820>. <RF>speaketh...: Heb. maketh his voice gracious<Rf>

<FI> Whose<Fi> hatred<WH08135> is covered<WH03680><WTH8691> by deceit<WH04860>, his wickedness<WH07451> shall be shewed<WH01540><WTH8735> before the <FI>whole<Fi> congregation<WH06951>. <RF>by...: or, in secret<Rf><CM>
Whoso diggeth<WH03738><WTH8802> a pit<WH07845> shall fall<WH05307><WTH8799> therein: and he that rolleth<WH01556><WTH8802> a stone<WH068>, it will return<WH07725><WTH8799> upon him.<CM>
A lying<WH08267> tongue<WH03956> hateth<WH08130><WTH8799> <FI>those that are<Fi> afflicted<WH01790> by it; and a flattering<WH02509> mouth<WH06310> worketh<WH06213><WTH8799> ruin<WH04072>.<CM>
